notes: Not automated: [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] If your opponent's Leader has 6000 power or more, set up to 1 of your DON!! cards as active. Then, your {Red-Haired Pirates} type Leader's base power becomes 6000 until the end of your opponent's next End Phase.
